checkpoint_phase: Phase 3: Process Internal Documents + Phase 2: Load External Evidence
description: Complete inventory of all evidence items (internal and external) with tier classification, ERS scoring, and capability mapping. Single source of truth for evidence traceability.

external_evidence.source: A1_Evidence_Inventory.csv (from research package or public sources)

evidence_items.source_type: [Regulatory Filing / News Article / Analyst Report / Government Database / Third-Party Survey / etc.]
evidence_items.fact_summary: [Concise 1-2 sentence summary of what this evidence shows]
evidence_items.fact_text: [Full quoted or paraphrased fact from source; max 200 words]
evidence_items.url_or_citation: [URL or full citation if not URL-accessible]
evidence_items.recency_age_months: [Months since publication; calculated as current_date - document_date]
evidence_items.ers_score: [(0.35 × tier_score) + (0.25 × recency_score) + (0.20 × specificity_score) + (0.20 × corroboration_score); rounded to 1 decimal]
evidence_items.supported_capabilities: [Array of P[1-4]C[1-5] IDs supported by this evidence]
evidence_items.maturity_implication: [M1–M5 level range that evidence suggests for supported capabilities]
evidence_items.confidence_indicator: [HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW; reflects strength and relevance of evidence]
evidence_items.cross_references: [Array of other Evidence IDs that corroborate or contradict this one]

internal_evidence.collection_method: [5-layer analysis for each document per skill methodology]

evidence_items.source_document: [Document ID and name, e.g., 'DOC-003: Board Strategy Deck 2024']
evidence_items.source_type: [Board Deck / Audit Report / Risk Register / Strategy Document / Policy Document / etc.]
evidence_items.tier: [T2 / T3 / T4; internal documents rarely T1, never T5]
evidence_items.corroboration_score: [1.0–5.0; within-org corroboration if multiple internal docs support]
evidence_items.ers_score: [Calculated per ERS formula; for T2/T4 internal docs typically 2.5–4.0]
evidence_items.internal_validation_notes: [Notes from 5-layer analysis; e.g., 'Corroborates public claims' or 'Contradicts public disclosure']
evidence_items.cross_references: [External evidence IDs that align or conflict with this internal fact]

evidence_tier_distribution.distribution_assessment: [E.g., 'Healthy mix with 45% T1/T2, 35% T3, 20% T4; no T5 marketing claims' or 'Heavy T5 reliance (18%); recommend additional T1/T2 evidence collection']

evidence_by_capability.capability_coverage: [Summary: how many capabilities have evidence, how many have zero evidence]
evidence_by_capability.sparse_evidence_capabilities: [Array of P[1-4]C[1-5] with 1–2 evidence items only]
evidence_by_capability.zero_evidence_capabilities: [Array of capabilities with no evidence; likely to score N/A]

contradiction_tracking.contradiction_log_reference: [Link to detailed contradiction_log.json if separate file]

sample_contradictions.conflict_type: [T1 vs T3 / Timing Conflict / Quantification Mismatch / etc.]
sample_contradictions.resolution: [Which source wins and why; per skill precedence rules]
sample_contradictions.score_impact: [Which capabilities affected; how score should be derived from resolved fact]

evidence_age_distribution.current_year: [Count and % of evidence from current FY]

evidence_recency_analysis.staleness_flags: [Any evidence >24 months old that would trigger -0.3 staleness discount]
evidence_recency_analysis.currency_assessment: [E.g., '72% of evidence within 12 months; recency is strong' or 'Only 45% current; many historical sources; may limit confidence']

evidence_completeness_check.description: All evidence items have required fields populated (ID, source, tier, fact, capability mapping)

ers_calculation_validation.validation_notes: [Any calculation issues; e.g., 'All ERS values within 1.0–5.0 range ✓']

capability_mapping_validation.coverage_percentage: [% of P1–P4 capabilities with at least one evidence item]
capability_mapping_validation.unmapped_evidence: [Evidence items not mapped to any capability; should be minimal]

contradiction_log_validation.all_resolved: [true / false; all contradictions have resolution documented]
